div.p: In the embedded system modeling field, the AADL has gradually become the industry standard because of the characteristics of modeling hardware/software collaborative. Based on the AADL formal characteristics, many domestic and foreign scholars launched a warm discussion. In order to help the system developers to better understand AADL, guide the software development process, improve software development efficiency, we discuss the AADL model reliability analysis, schedulability analysis and AADL model testing on the three different viewpoints of the AADL formal verification theory. By contrasting, we discuss their advantages and insufficiencies. Then we briefly introduced the AADL verification tool, and focus on the issue of how to construct embedded software development platform based on AADL.

div.head: INTRODUCTION
div.p: Along with the computer application domain unceasing expansion, the computer software development scale is gradually broadened, and the complexity of software is increasing. It leads to the development cycle and development cost increase. In order to solve these problems, the Object Management Group (OMG) put forward a new method-Model Driven Structure (MDA) [1] method. The core idea of MDA is using the system model as center; the system model is separated from the system implementation. By this way the software development process is simplified for the establishment of business logic model and it can automatically generate code on the specific computing platform. In MDA, modeling language is not only a design language; it is also a programming language. For the complexity problem that emerged in the embedded software development field, the industry proposed an architecture modeling language-AADL. (Architecture Analysis and Design Language) [2] , which is based on the MDA idea. The AADL is a modeling language which is mainly used to design the software and hardware architecture of crucial real-time system. From the mathematical perspective, the AADL is merely a semi-formal language. The core idea of the AADL reliability analysis and assessment is mainly about translating the AADL into the Petri network formal model, and then put the Petrie network model into the corresponding formal tools to verify. Based on the idea of AADL model's reliability, many scholars have done related reached. The literature [3] proposed translating the AADL model of embedded system into a reliability calculation model of general stochastic Petri net(GSPN),The AADL model reliability verification can be achieved indirectly by validating the GSPN model. This method can realize the evaluation automation about the reliability of AADL. According to the former validate process, this method design and develop the verification tool-ARAM (AADL reliability assessment model). The literature [4] also put forward the same verification idea that base on model transformation which converted AADL model to general stochastic Petri net. But base on the exist AAD mode transform rules it focused more on component error and error propagation between system components. As well it also discusses properties of Guard Transition on error propagation. At last it instituted the conversion rules that from the AADL model to GSPN based on AADL behavior annex. This paper using the flight control system data transmission and processing unit for example, it verifies the conversion rules and expound the reliability of AADL model. The literature [5] has a detail analysis of software internal error status and error propagation, it constructs the AADL error model. It converts the AADL error model to a generalized stochastic network model cording to the basic rules of conversion, its calculation was carried out by using the exist tools which is available, As the same as former, it also realized the fault tolerant software system reliability evaluation, this literature analyzed the component failure rate and received the good effect based on the application of scene experiment that related to the air traffic control system (ATC).

The conversion that AADL model to generalized stochastic network reliability calculation model is the main way of the reliability evaluation, not only it considered a single component validation, but also taken into account the dependencies among components, so it can be considered the overall system reliability. AADL model of reliability requires repeated iteration to obtain in the verification process, this can help the project developers understand the system model structure and properties more deeply.

div.head: III. AADL SCHEDULABILITY VERIFICATION
div.p: As the embedded system have very strict non-functional requirements, especially the system response time. Thus, how to quickly get the system response is the key that AADL needs to be considered. The AADL schedulability verification can be used to solve the problem. The literature [6] focus on schedulability verification problem of architecture analysis and design language (AADL) model and put forward the model checker UPPAAL to formal analyze and validate schedulability of the thread component in a preemptive scheduling strategy. The literature realized the model transformation tools that can translate the AADL model to UPPAAL model. The literature [7] is the further achieved about AADL behavior model analysis and verification. Firstly, it proposes the transformation rules from AADL model to timed automata model-UPPAAL. These are based on the grammar structure of AADL behavior annex and behavior description. After the former theory it designs and implements the prototyping tools. In the literature, it gets the AADL model that modeling the gyro number from the control of spacecraft guidance, navigation and control computer as an example, and translate the model in simulation under UPPAAL through the automatic conversion rules, finally it can verify the correctness of AADL behaviors or prove that the model transformation is effective. Although UPPAAL is a good analysis tool to verification the AADL model schedulability, in practice it also has some important disadvantages, such as it's difficult to validate the AADL model schedulability under the preemptible scheduling strategy. This can be supplemented by the literature [8].It designs a kind of AADL model schedulability analysis and verifies tools -UcaS which base on the AADL and constrained clock automata theory. The literature performs the test on the UcaS tool. Although UCaS can realize the preemptible strategy under the AADL model schedulability, but its efficiency is relatively low and lack of stability. It also needs to further improve the algorithm and make the efficiency of execution better.

In the AADL schedulability, timed automata is an important formal model. The main idea is converted the AADL model to the timed automata. And then use the time automata tools to verify it. It is the main approach for verifying AADL schedulability at present. For the AADL model schedulability verification, it also has some other theory methods. The literature [9] proposed the validate method that translating AADL model into a time Petri net formal model and using the tool TINA which based on time Petri net for verification. In literature [9],it introduced the structure of the TINA . The working principle of this tool is translating the AADL model into intermediate language of Fiacre, then compiling the Fiacre model to Abstract time automata for verification. Thereby it can indirectly validate the correctness of the AADL model scheduling. This tool has been used as a plug-in to be integrated in TOPCASED tools. The above analysis about AADL scheduling that is mainly for formal modeling. It is key to ensure the real-time system in early development

div.head: IV. AADL MODEL TESTING METHOD
div.p: At present, AADL has been widely applied in the field of embedded system, how to ensure the quality of the mission critical system, it also need to give the system testing model for testing the AADL model. Based on this problem, the references [10] [11] were put forward the schema of testing method. This method applied Markov chain to describe the architecture of AADL behavior and generated the test cases and test predictions according to the Markove chain and system design requirements . Then it can judge the AADL model by contrasting test outcome and expected value. The former test outcome has been achieved by executing the test cases in Markove chain model. It is the realization of the system AADL model test; finally, the literature enumerates some examples to expound the effectiveness of the proven process.

Markov chain test method is a static testing method. Its model transformation is mainly based on the individual component, when considering the whole system structure, it needs to layer the entire system component and describe the component operating mode and component error state in system. Because it is only analysis for component transferring and testing component state in AADL model, it is lack of connection analysis between the communication components. At present, the model test method based on the Markov chain model remain stays in the theory perspective. There are no test tools for its theory. In addition ,for the more complex structure of the AADL system model, how to generate appropriate test cases to coverage all the branches of the test model and how to optimize these test cases are also the problem that we need further study.

Based on the testing model research, the reference [12] provided the formalized AADL test model definition and constructed an algorithm on the basis of definition. The test algorithm can reflect the system topology structure. According to the test algorithm, we can assess the component interaction of AADL design model .The evaluation of the interaction include connect sequence between the input and output port or the correctness of interaction. Finally, for the flight control system of the AADL model as an example, it introduces the whole process of analysis. Because the purpose of designing AADL test model is to find out the design model problem and ensure the AADL model correctness as soon as possible. So it is the important content in AADL research .we need to develop the suitable software development tool for AADL model test.

div.head: V. AADL FORMAL VERIFICATION TOOLS AND SYSTEM
div.p: Since the formal methods play an important role in the AADL model analysis. In the practice of embedded software development, it is very difficult for engineer to master and use. Therefore, the formal language tool for AADL model analysis becomes very urgent.

Cheddar is a real time scheduling analysis tool that is developed by the French Brest University. It estimates the AADL model schedulability by using the simulation technique. This tool provides support for single processor scheduling, multiprocessor scheduling, sharing resources scheduling and so on. And it has been used as a plugin for STOOD or TOPCASED. FURNESS is a formal verification tool which based on process algebra language (ACSR) [ 13] .It has simple structure. But it can simulate the real time scheduling and resource competition relationship. Furness often used as a plugin for OSTATE. Similar as Furness, TIMES can also analyses the real time scheduling, and as an important tool for validating the correctness of system scheduling. But the TASM validates the system based on the time state machine, it can formulate the process of system performance, so it is the effective tool to support AADL model schedulability. Maude is generated based on the concept of the rewriting logic, it uses sequential logic to represent the AADL scheduling process and operational semantics.

At present,there has been more and more study base on AADL model.It also causes various verification theory and validation tools for AADL model on many different views.In order to develop software better base on the MDE, how to integrate the AADL formal validation tools, and combined with the automatic code generation techniques to establish embedded system development platform is our next consideration. Using the platform we can design the AADL model,simulate the real-time system scheduling , validate the reliability of AADL model ,and automatic generate the code on the particular target.The platform is convenient for the whole software developing process.In the aspect of the theory of platform development about drive the AADL model to real-time system,the literature [14] use AADL as the research object, put forward the development platform applying to the automotive electronics embedded software. But its research obtain the implementation of the AADL system model and conversion that from AADL model to Simulink function model code.And it can build the cross compile environment.But it has no strict proof to prove this platform can meet all the non -functional requirement attributes.It is lacks correctness verification of real-time system. The prototype tool-Lambda MDE [15] is the new embedded software development platform. Lambda MDE contains all the embedded software development process such as the system modeling, system simulation, code generation, and system testing. But it still lacks supports for the error model. The model validation ability is poor, and the system efficiency and stability are not perfect. So how to combine formal methods and theory to establish reliable development platform for embedded software is still our further exploration.

div.head: VI. CONCLUSION
div.p: AADL is the foundation in the embedded software development that based on model driven architecture in future. It has received numerous supports in industry. The AADL annex is also in expansion, its formal theory research is also continuing, and it still not establishes the standard verification system. AADL model verification platform is the Model Driven Development foundation for embedded system. Therefore, we should also explore AADL formal semantics more deeply, improving its formal theory tool, building the development platform for the whole process base on AADL. It can provide effective support to software development in early.

The AADL model just can describe the part corresponding properties of the component, such as the thread execution time, component security level, error tree of the component model. If you want to analyze the other non-functional properties about AADL system model, it needs to analyze the system component model and formal verification component properties .The approach of AADL formal verification is to translate the AADL model to other low level formal model, and then input the formal model to related tools to test and verify. It can identify AADL errors in the model, and then the engineer can correct the error and improve the model. By this way, the developer can obtain high reliability AADL model. It can lay a solid foundation for the development of large-scale complex, safety and reliability of embedded system in the early stage. In China, the formalized research around AADL model has become a hot spot currently, this paper studied a variety of formal methods about the AADL, reviewed the theoretical research and found inadequate about AADL model. These can provide reference to embedded software engineer for the early development II. RELIABILITY RESEARCH OF AADL
